description: The line plot illustrates the performance change, measured by minFDE₂₀ (lower values indicate better performance), as a function of the ratio of the in-context pool size, with the x-axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled minFDE₂₀ (←), ranges from 0.8 to 1.3. Five methods are compared: TrajICL (blue circles, solid line), Head Tuning (orange circles, solid line), FT (green circles, solid line), LoRA 16 (red circles, solid line), and LoRA 64 (purple circles, solid line). At a ratio of 0.0, TrajICL starts at approximately 0.91, Head Tuning at 1.32, FT at 1.12, LoRA 16 at 1.22, and LoRA 64 at 1.22. As the ratio increases, Head Tuning shows a consistent decrease, starting at 1.32 and ending at 1.12. FT shows a sharp decline, starting at 1.12 and ending at 0.80. LoRA 16 and LoRA 64 both start at 1.22 and show a gradual decline, with LoRA 16 ending at 0.96 and LoRA 64 at 0.96. TrajICL remains relatively stable, starting at 0.91 and ending at 0.87. All methods show a general trend of decreasing minFDE₂₀ as the ratio increases, indicating improved performance with larger in-context pools.
